title: SN TOOL - Official Release v2.0.5 (Complete Genuine Downloader, Nisay AI & Catalog Upgrade)
release_notes:
• 🎯 100% Genuine Drama Downloader & Stream Resolution: Eliminated fake fallbacks and duplicate spoofing, enforced strict stream resolution, and accurately flagged unavailable episodes.
• 🔄 Instant Random Discovery & Fresh Catalog Rotation: Refreshing the catalog now rotates fresh dramas dynamically across platforms.
• 🧠 Nisay Translation Circuit Breaker & Fallback: Added automatic failover/circuit-breaker resilience plus expanded speaker persona detection for accurate male/female voice assignment.
• 🛡️ License & UI Integrity Upgrades: Eliminated false-positive hardware lockouts, added dynamic days-left display on the license badge, and enabled manual Reinstall/Update modal access.
• 🧹 Storage & Performance Optimization: Cleaned legacy caches and synchronized all runtime modules.
